title: Expenses.
bodyText: The members of the committee and ad hoc committees shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for all necessary expenses incurred in the performance of their duties.
bodyHtml: [§23-67]  Expenses.  The members of the committee and ad hoc committees shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for all necessary expenses incurred in the performance of their duties. [L 1989, c 165, pt of §2]
